Moodles_Angry_desc_lvl2: Seriously bad mood. Hard on weapons, sloppy at fine work, slow to read.
Moodles_Angry_desc_lvl3: Ball of rage. Harder on weapons, sloppier, slower to read, and cursing out loud.
Moodles_Angry_desc_lvl4: Spoiling for a fight. Wrecking weapons, botching fine work, cursing loudly, and every swing tires you more.
Moodles_AirwayIrritation_Bad_desc_lvl1: Your chest feels tight. Get somewhere warm and clean.
Moodles_AirwayIrritation_Bad_desc_lvl3: Endurance is not recovering. You are coughing.
Moodles_AirwayIrritation_Bad_desc_lvl4: Endurance and health are draining. Use an inhaler or rest in clean air.
Moodles_Vitality_Bad_desc_lvl1: Poor food, no exercise or bad sleep are catching up. Endurance recovery and mood suffer a little.
Moodles_Vitality_Bad_desc_lvl2: Living on junk and no sleep. Carry weight and endurance recovery are down, mood is held low, colds catch easier, and any condition you have hits harder.
Moodles_Vitality_Good_desc_lvl1: Fresh food, exercise and sleep are paying off. Faster endurance recovery and a lift to mood.
Moodles_Vitality_Good_desc_lvl2: Eating well, training regularly, sleeping properly. Carry weight and endurance recovery are up, mood and stress ease, health mends, colds are shrugged off, Fitness and Strength train half as fast again, and any condition you have is easier to live with.
Moodles_SleptBadly_Bad_desc_lvl1: Last night was not great. Mood is a little low today; it wears off by evening, and a nap helps.
Moodles_SleptBadly_Bad_desc_lvl2: Broken or short sleep. Mood is held down, stress creeps up and you tire earlier. Wears off through the day; a couple of hours' nap halves it.
Moodles_SleptBadly_Bad_desc_lvl3: Almost no real sleep. Mood is low all day, stress builds and fatigue comes early. Nothing fixes it but sleep.
Moodles_Hangover_Bad_desc_lvl1: Last night is catching up: a headache, a low mood, thirst that keeps coming back, slower to get your breath back. It wears off; painkillers only dull it.
Moodles_Hangover_Bad_desc_lvl2: A proper hangover. Head pounding (worse in the sun), mood low, tired, thirsty and short of stamina. At least six hours after waking.
Moodles_Hangover_Bad_desc_lvl3: A brutal hangover: pain, nausea, exhaustion. A drink would hide it, and make the next one worse.
Moodles_Migraine_Bad_desc_lvl1: Lights look strange. A migraine is twenty minutes away: get somewhere dark. Sumatriptan now makes it half as bad.
Moodles_Migraine_Bad_desc_lvl2: Pain, nausea and blurred vision for hours. Painkillers barely help; sumatriptan does. Light drags it out (sunglasses help), a dark room or sleep ends it sooner.
Moodles_Migraine_Bad_desc_lvl3: A severe migraine. Stay in the dark, take sumatriptan if you have it, sleep if you can.
Moodles_BloodLoss_Bad_desc_lvl1: Lost some blood. Weak, slow to get your breath back, thirsty. Stop the bleeding, drink, rest.
Moodles_BloodLoss_Bad_desc_lvl2: Lost a lot of blood. The room tilts, the heart races; no sprinting. Stop the bleeding now.
Moodles_BloodLoss_Bad_desc_lvl3: Too little blood to go round. Cold, weak, confused, getting worse. Every drop counts.
Moodles_BloodLoss_Bad_desc_lvl4: Minutes left. Stop the bleeding or die.
Moodles_Infection_Bad_desc_lvl1: A wound is infected: hot, swollen, sore, and not healing. Disinfectant or garlic can still beat it. Antibiotics certainly will.
Moodles_Infection_Bad_desc_lvl2: The infection is in your blood. Burning up, tired and thirsty. Only antibiotics will stop it now: a dose every eight hours, and finish the course.
Moodles_Infection_Bad_desc_lvl3: The infection is winning. High fever and getting weaker by the hour. Antibiotics, now.
Moodles_Concussion_Bad_desc_lvl1: A knock to the head, or the headache that comes back days after one. Rest it off; sleep helps.
Moodles_Concussion_Bad_desc_lvl2: Headache, queasy, light hurts, the world spins if you run. Rest and sleep heal it; running and fighting drag it out.
Moodles_Concussion_Bad_desc_lvl3: A bad head injury. Another knock now would be much worse. Lie low.
Moodles_BloodSugar_Bad_desc_lvl1: Shaky, sweaty or thirsty, and hard to focus. Your blood sugar is drifting, high or low. A meter would tell you which.
Moodles_BloodSugar_Bad_desc_lvl2: Well out of range, one way or the other: tired, low, and your hands or your thirst are getting worse. Check it. Low: something sweet, now. High: insulin.
Moodles_BloodSugar_Bad_desc_lvl3: Dangerously high or low, and your health is draining. A bad low can put you on the floor. Act now.
Moodles_ChestPain_Bad_desc_lvl1: Your heart is being pushed. Ease off and it settles.
Moodles_ChestPain_Bad_desc_lvl2: Close to chest pain. Stop and rest, or take it slow.
Moodles_ChestPain_Bad_desc_lvl3: A tight, crushing pain. No running, swings cost more, endurance barely recovers. Stop and rest and it passes in a quarter of an hour; nitroglycerin ends it in a minute.
Moodles_ChestPain_Bad_desc_lvl4: You are pushing on through chest pain. Stop now, or your heart gives out.
Moodles_ChestPain_Good_desc_lvl1: Starting to help. A few days of a pill a day and chest pain and heart attacks will be much less likely.
Moodles_ChestPain_Good_desc_lvl2: Chest pain and heart attacks are much less likely. Take the next pill within a day.
Moodles_WeakHeart_Bad_desc_lvl1: The last days after a heart attack. Endurance comes back a fifth slower, effort costs a little more, swings are a fifth weaker.
Moodles_WeakHeart_Bad_desc_lvl2: Recovering from a heart attack. Endurance comes back at two thirds, effort costs a third more, swings are a third weaker.
Moodles_WeakHeart_Bad_desc_lvl3: The first days after a heart attack. Endurance comes back at half speed, effort costs half as much again, swings do half damage. Another attack within a day could kill you.
Moodles_Seizure_Bad_desc_lvl1: Confused, aching and low. It lifts within the hour.
Moodles_Seizure_Bad_desc_lvl2: A strange feeling rising. You have a few minutes: get somewhere safe, stop the car, put down what you are holding.
Moodles_Seizure_Good_desc_lvl1: Starting to help. A few days of a pill every 12 hours and seizures will be much rarer.
Moodles_Seizure_Good_desc_lvl2: Seizures are much rarer. Take the next pill within 12 hours.
Moodles_Tinnitus_Bad_desc_lvl1: Hard of Hearing until it fades, and light sleep is lighter. More gunfire makes it last longer.
Moodles_Tinnitus_Bad_desc_lvl2: Your ears are ringing badly: an hour or more of Hard of Hearing.
Moodles_GutFlare_Bad_desc_lvl1: Something you ate disagrees with you. It is only starting.
Moodles_GutFlare_Bad_desc_lvl2: Cramps, queasy and low. It takes hours to clear; sleep helps a little.
Moodles_GutFlare_Bad_desc_lvl3: Pain and nausea from what you ate. Nothing to do but wait it out.
Moodles_Filthy_Bad_desc_lvl1: Dirt and blood on you or your clothes. It is getting to you: stress creeps up.
Moodles_Filthy_Bad_desc_lvl2: You can't stand the state you are in. Stress builds and your mood is held down. Wash and change.
Moodles_Filthy_Bad_desc_lvl3: Caked in filth. Stress climbs fast and your mood is on the floor. Wash and change.
Moodles_Sunburn_Bad_desc_lvl1: You have been in the sun a while. Cover up, find shade, or put on sun block.
Moodles_Sunburn_Bad_desc_lvl2: Bare skin has burnt. It hurts, there, for a day, and makes for a worse night. More sun on it starts the day over.
Moodles_Sunburn_Bad_desc_lvl3: Burnt over much of your body. Agony for most of a day, and a bad night ahead. Painkillers help; stay out of the sun.
Moodles_Sunburn_Good_desc_lvl1: The sun can't burn you. One coat lasts eight hours.
Moodles_Dehydration_Bad_desc_lvl1: You have gone thirsty too long. A headache, and you tire sooner. Drink; it clears in a couple of hours.
Moodles_Dehydration_Bad_desc_lvl2: Dizzy and drained. Headache, tiredness and slow to get your breath back. Drink.
Moodles_CaffeineWithdrawal_Bad_desc_lvl1: Half a day without caffeine. A headache is starting and you are tired and low. Coffee or tea fixes it; cola or chocolate puts it off for a few hours.
Moodles_CaffeineWithdrawal_Bad_desc_lvl2: Headache, tiredness and low mood. It peaks after a day or so; a week without breaks the habit.
Moodles_AlcoholWithdrawal_Bad_desc_lvl1: A day dry. Stress, low mood and a short temper climb and sleep is poor. A drink ends it; a month without ends it for good.
Moodles_AlcoholWithdrawal_Bad_desc_lvl2: Pain, nausea, a worse temper and shaking hands: weapons slip. A drink ends it.
Moodles_AlcoholWithdrawal_Bad_desc_lvl3: Seeing and hearing things, and seizures. The worst of it lasts days.
Moodles_NicotineCraving_Bad_desc_lvl1: The craving is starting. Irritable and hungry.
Moodles_NicotineCraving_Bad_desc_lvl2: You need a cigarette. Irritable, hungry, sleeping badly. Nicotine gum takes the edge off.
Moodles_NicotineCraving_Bad_desc_lvl3: The craving is all you can think about. Three weeks without tobacco breaks the habit.
Moodles_Depression_Bad_desc_lvl1: A depressive episode. Mood is held down for days. Exercise, time outdoors, comfort food and medication shorten it.
Moodles_Depression_Bad_desc_lvl2: Mood is held low and sleep is poor. Drink helps today and makes it worse tomorrow.
Moodles_Depression_Bad_desc_lvl3: A severe episode. Everything is an effort. Keep up the habits that help and ride it out.
Moodles_LowIron_Bad_desc_lvl1: Running short of iron. Eat fresh meat, fish, eggs or greens, or take an iron pill.
Moodles_LowIron_Bad_desc_lvl2: Short of iron: endurance recovers slower, you tire sooner and feel the cold.
Moodles_LowIron_Bad_desc_lvl3: Badly short of iron. Weak and tired, slow to mend. Meat or iron pills, soon.
Moodles_StiffJoints_Bad_desc_lvl1: The weather is getting into your joints. A little slower to move and swing.
Moodles_StiffJoints_Bad_desc_lvl2: Cold and damp have your joints flaring: slower, sore, and your grip is unreliable. Get warm and dry.
Moodles_StiffJoints_Bad_desc_lvl3: Your joints are seized with cold. Slow, in pain, and likely to drop what you swing. Get warm and dry.
Moodles_MSHeat_Bad_desc_lvl1: The warmth is wearing you down. You tire sooner. Find shade.
Moodles_MSHeat_Bad_desc_lvl2: Your hands are stiff, clumsy and sore, and a weapon can slip. Cool down: shade, water, wet clothes.
Moodles_MSHeat_Bad_desc_lvl3: Severe pain and hands that give out. Get cool now.
Moodles_MSFlare_Bad_desc_lvl1: A flare, eased by prednisone: it will pass sooner.
Moodles_MSFlare_Bad_desc_lvl2: Heavy legs, weak hands, exhaustion, and the heat hits harder. Prednisone shortens it.
Moodles_Spoons_Bad_desc_lvl1: Half of today's energy is spent. Plan the rest of the day. A bad night leaves fewer spoons to start with, on top of the night itself.
Moodles_Spoons_Bad_desc_lvl2: A few spoons left. Stamina comes back slowly and the legs are stiff. Sit down and rest: it gives a little back.
Moodles_Spoons_Bad_desc_lvl3: Nothing left. Heavy tiredness, legs like lead, stamina at a crawl, a grip that slips. Every hour you push on is borrowed from tomorrow. Rest, or sleep. A coffee hides it for an hour.
Moodles_LightTooBright_Bad_desc_lvl1: The light is getting into the migraine: more pain, and the attack lingers. Find somewhere darker.
Moodles_LightTooBright_Bad_desc_lvl2: The light is drilling into your head: more pain, and a longer attack. Lights off, a dark room, or sunglasses.
Moodles_LightTooBright_Bad_desc_lvl3: Sunlight is agony: much more pain, and the attack drags on twice as long. Get indoors and out of the light.
Moodles_TriptanAfter_Bad_desc_lvl1: The day after sumatriptan: you tire sooner and your grip can slip mid-swing. Wears off within a day of the pill.
Moodles_Antidepressants_Good_desc_lvl1: In your system, not at full effect yet. That takes three days of a pill a day; a missed day sets it back.
Moodles_Antidepressants_Good_desc_lvl2: Episodes are rarer, milder and shorter. Keep taking one a day.
Moodles_Home_Bad_desc_lvl1: Two days away from home, one for a Homebody. Your mood sinks a little until you are back.
Moodles_Home_Bad_desc_lvl2: Days away. Low mood holds, worse for a Homebody, who also sleeps badly away and frets. Walking back in lifts it at once.
Moodles_Home_Good_desc_lvl1: A few nights in the same place and it is starting to feel like home. Boredom, worry and low moods ease here, nights score a little better and books go a little faster.
Moodles_Home_Good_desc_lvl2: A week or more in the same place. Boredom, stress and low moods ease while you are here, nights slept here score better and books go faster. Twice as much for a Homebody.
Moodles_StaleClothes_Bad_desc_lvl1: Days of sweat in what you are wearing. Your mood dips a little until you change or wash them.
Moodles_StaleClothes_Bad_desc_lvl2: Something you are wearing stayed damp too long and smells of it. Your mood dips a little more until it is washed and dried properly.
Moodles_StaleClothes_Good_desc_lvl1: Everything you are wearing is clean, dry and fresh. Your mood and your nerves ease a little while it lasts.
Moodles_StaleClothes_Good_desc_lvl2: Clean clothes that dried on a line in the sun. Your mood and your nerves ease twice as much while it lasts.
Moodles_GoodRead_Good_desc_lvl1: You finished a book. About two days of a small bonus set by its genre.
Moodles_GoodRead_Good_desc_lvl2: A book worth the hours, or one in a genre you love. The genre's bonus, stronger.
Moodles_GoodRead_Good_desc_lvl3: A great book in the genre you love. The genre's bonus at its strongest.
Moodles_SensoryLoad_Bad_desc_lvl1: Too much input, and it adds up. Stress is held up. Somewhere quiet, clothes that don't scratch and a wash bring it down.
Moodles_SensoryLoad_Bad_desc_lvl2: Everything is too much. Stress and unhappiness are held up, everything you do takes longer and you get your breath back slower. Get away from it.
Moodles_SensoryLoad_Bad_desc_lvl3: Overloaded. Panic and anger take over: you throw down what you hold and shout out loud, and everything takes far longer. Get somewhere quiet and dark; a fidget toy or a safe food helps. Only safe food goes down.
Moodles_SensoryLoad_Bad_desc_lvl4: Overloaded. You have gone quiet and flat: no energy, no running, nothing matters, and everything takes far longer. Rest somewhere quiet; a fidget toy or a safe food helps. Only safe food goes down.
Moodles_SoreMuscles_Bad_desc_lvl1: Trained hard. These muscles earn less experience until they recover, and pushing them risks a pulled muscle. Sleep, good food and stretching speed recovery.
Moodles_SoreMuscles_Bad_desc_lvl2: Muscles worked past their limit. Training them now earns little and can pull a muscle. Rest them.
Moodles_SoreMuscles_Bad_desc_lvl3: A pulled muscle: it hurts, it is stiff, and it cannot be trained for a day and a half. Sleep heals it twice as fast.
Moodles_Pumped_Bad_desc_lvl1: Two days without a workout. Boredom and stress creep up until you get one in.
Moodles_Pumped_Good_desc_lvl1: Stretched out. Muscles recover faster, stiffness fades sooner and stiff joints ache less for a few hours.
Moodles_Pumped_Good_desc_lvl2: A good workout. Stress, low mood and boredom ease for a few hours, and it counts against depression.
Moodles_Overtrained_Bad_desc_lvl1: Seven hard days in a row. Training earns less, sleep is worse and stamina comes back slower. Two easy days put it right.
Moodles_BackStrain_Bad_desc_lvl1: A heavy load has the lower back aching. It stiffens the legs a little and slows you down. Set the load down and rest. A trained core takes longer to get here.
Moodles_BackStrain_Bad_desc_lvl2: The back is bad. Pain, stiff legs, slower walking, and one more heavy lift could throw it out. Put the load down.
Moodles_BackStrain_Bad_desc_lvl3: Thrown out. Severe pain, a stiff back and legs, and no running for about four hours. Likelier again for a week.
Moodles_Hyperfocus_Good_desc_lvl1: Keep at it and you'll lock in.
Moodles_Hyperfocus_Good_desc_lvl2: Locked in. Jobs go quicker, you learn a little more, and boredom can't touch you. Walking between jobs is fine; stopping for a few minutes, panic or sleep breaks it.
Moodles_GoodMeal_Bad_desc_lvl1: Trained on a full stomach. A stitch in the side: let it settle before you go again.
Moodles_GoodMeal_Good_desc_lvl1: A proper home-cooked meal. Low mood and stress ease for a few hours, and training pays a little more.
Moodles_GoodMeal_Good_desc_lvl2: A chef's meal. Low mood and stress ease for hours, and training pays more.
Moodles_MedsDue_Bad_desc_lvl1: Time for your next dose of a daily medication. The health panel shows when you last took each one.
Moodles_MedsDue_Bad_desc_lvl2: A daily medication has worn off. Its effect slips away the longer you go without: take a dose.
